CV: Protein+cap mass COM separation from a documented substrate reference group along a validated surface normal; use a differentiable, unwrapped periodic-coordinate implementation.
grid_note: Relative displacements from a prepared bound orientation; these are not absolute surface distances or a claim of a bound state. Window positions must be rebuilt from validated geometry.
required_before_execution: verified bound-state/orientation ensemble, not an arbitrary initial close placement
surface model/force field validated and equilibrated
solvent-only protein and protein-free surface controls
enlarged solvent cell: full displacement range cannot reuse the current cell without image/separation checks
defined protein/substrate atom groups and a continuous CV, including PBC unit tests
consistent lateral/orientation restraints with their entropic effects quantified
prepared and equilibrated window starts with safe forces; budget authorization is not a convergence test
required_analysis: overlap matrix of neighboring CV histograms
autocorrelation-aware effective samples; independent runs and block stability
WHAM/MBAR with uncertainty and coordinate/Jacobian conventions stated
desorbed-region stability, no patch-edge escape and no periodic-image artifacts
orientation/lateral restraint and standard-state/area corrections before any adsorption free-energy claim
allowed_interpretation: At first, an orientation-conditional PMF for a defined finite model. Neither a raw restraint energy nor a conditional PMF alone is experimental retention or a standard binding free energy.
